notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is Live!
notes.content:
Hi, düstenburguers!

We have released a new bug fix patch so you can continue Abigail's adventure.

We hope that with this patch of corrections the quality of your gaming sessions will improve. Thank you very much to all those who have contacted us to us in Steam Discussions and by private message on Twitter to report the bugs.

Many thanks to all of you!

[b][h3]Patch notes[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed cutscene with Abigail and Ulrik
[*] Fixed transition from Abigail to Cursed Slums from the Hospital.
[*] Fixed Abigail's hat warning positions for the Realm of the Dead.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is Live!
notes.content:
Hi, düstenburguers!

First of all, we want to thank the entire community that has been supporting us all this time by reporting bugs and giving feedback to improve the game experience.

We hope that with this patch of corrections the quality of your gaming sessions will improve. Also, we will notify you of future updates very soon.

Many thanks to all of you!

[h3][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h3]

[list]
    [*]Map collisions fixed.
    [*]Fixed game crash after interacting with the soul in the kitchen.
    [*]Fixed automatic save error in Case 1.
    [*]Fixed error in the pause menu.
    [*]Grammar corrections.
[/list]
